name: Kalyani Nagar
civicNote: Administered by PMC's Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri ward office.
summary: A mostly residential neighbourhood in east Pune on the north bank of the Mula-Mutha, across the river from Koregaon Park.
knownFor: Aga Khan Palace, where Mahatma Gandhi was held from 1942 to 1945
connectivity: Pune Metro Line 2 (Aqua) Kalyani Nagar station, open since March 2024
Aga Khan Bridge connects it to Koregaon Park
About 4 km from Pune airport and about 5 km from Pune Junction
suits: Households wanting an established central-east neighbourhood near the airport, Koregaon Park and a metro line.
